shifts.operations: Drilled out 13-3/8 in shoe track at 3,850 m MD. Performed Formation Integrity Test (FIT) to 12.10 ppg EMW (1.45 SG). Commenced 12-1/4 in open hole drilling in Upper Miocene compact marine shale (U1).
shifts.handover_notes: Parameters stable. WOB 18 klbf, RPM 120, standpipe pressure steady. Background gas 0.3%. Shakers showing firm shale cuttings.

shifts.operations: Drilling 12-1/4 in hole in U1 shale seal. Hole cleaning good; swept 30 bbl high-vis pill at 4,020 m.
shifts.handover_notes: Torque steady at 12.5 kft-lb. LWD telemetry 100% decode. Connection gas < 0.5%. Continue drilling ahead as per program.

shifts.operations: Drilling ahead in basal U1. Approaching prognosed top of Miocene transition zone (U2) at 4,150 m.
shifts.handover_notes: Mud weight maintained at 11.20 ppg. Standpipe pressure steady. Mud logger alerted to monitor sonic slowness and dxc trends closely.

shifts.operations: Entered U2 transition zone at 4,150 m. Observed initial dxc trend departure. At 4,172 m MD, agent watchdog alert fired: sonic slowness departure +12 μs/ft off NCT, connection gas rising from 0.8% to 2.4%. Warning point reached.
shifts.handover_notes: Sagar Drishti Agent flagged 200 psi underbalance ramp in 23 m. Superintendent convened MOC review. Flow check negative. Barite staging commenced.

shifts.operations: Executed MOC-MN-SM-DW-01-003: weighted active mud system from 11.20 to 11.65 ppg using 39.8 MT (796 bags) barite. Circulated and conditioned mud to uniform density. Resumed controlled drilling through U2 base.
shifts.handover_notes: Reached 4,195 m MD (offset MN-DW-02 kick depth). Maintained +120 psi overbalance. Zero pit gain, zero gas influx.

shifts.operations: Tagged U3 main turbidite gas sand at 4,195 m. Encountered drilling break at 4,205 m (instantaneous ROP 34 m/hr). Immediately capped ROP at 12 m/hr as per SOP-04 recommendation to prevent annular overloading. ECD controlled at 11.86 ppg (safe by 0.24 ppg below 12.10 shoe FIT).
shifts.handover_notes: Preempted offset MN-DW-03 loss precedent (28 bbl/hr). Mud losses 0 bbl. Excellent sand quality: 24.2% porosity, dry gas C1 > 88%.

shifts.operations: Drilling through U3 sand base into U4 argillaceous limestone at 4,290 m. Cuttings transition to light grey dolomitic limestone. Torque increased from 11 kft-lb to 16 kft-lb.
shifts.handover_notes: ROP naturally declining in hard carbonate stringers. Gas dropped to 0.4%. Mud properties stable.

shifts.operations: Reached section Total Depth (TD) at 4,450 m MD / TVD. Circulated hole clean; pumped 50 bbl high-density sweep. Performed wiper trip to casing shoe; zero drag or tight hole observed. Prepared for logging and 9-5/8 in casing run.
shifts.handover_notes: Section completed with ZERO lost-time incidents and ZERO kicks. Autonomous WCR generation initiated.
